svg.title: Korea · dynasties, colonisation and division
svg.desc: Selected, sourced connections. Arrows label unions, divisions, conquest, independence, changes in rule, and contact. Node positions do not measure time or ancestry. This map follows the histories already in the atlas and does not claim to start Korean history with Goryeo. Division in 1945 and state establishment in 1948 are separate events. Select a node for Wikipedia or an arrow for its sources.
svg.text: Tap a node to read · Tap an arrow for the event and sources
